question: Owner 2026-11-01 '不动原来的仓位和杠杆逻辑 … 只不过是基于原有的实际持仓量翻倍': loss doubling on top of the live-wick account sizing
single_variable: Sizing only: margin = equity / n x 2^level (level = consecutive losing closes, reset after a win, capped); fills, stop, target, costs unchanged
in_sample: Same history as every live-wick result
note: A level whose margin exceeds equity (3x3 level 2 = 4/3 of equity, 6x3 level 3 = 8/6) can never fill and the account stops trading; feasible caps are 1 for 3x3 and 2 for 6x3. First run had max_levels [2, 3].
